race.comment: JUST SAY VALE (4) only warmed late to finish sixth at Eagle Farm on debut. Came with a neat price tag to the Tony Gollan's stable and is expected to be much better the further she stretches in distance. Bold showing anticipated. SPIRIT OF TORQUE (7) is knocking on the door of a break through win, finishing third in an Open company here after a slow start. Dropping back to a Mdn provides a strong class advantage, and her wet-track record adds to her appeal. NOTES OF AUTUMN (5) improved at Gatton, finishing fifth after a slow start. Will be further improved third-up and should appreciate the rise in trip. Thompson's booking is another good push. TISANI JAMES (3) drops back from the same race as SPIRIT OF TORQUE and is looms an each-way hope.
